content:
zoe: quick - saw a puzzling ESM/CJS import shape in the JS SDK sample when building for edge. dynamic import sometimes returns a double-wrapped default and breaks `adapter` access.
max: can you paste the tiny repro?
zoe: minimal: conditional import of './adapters/modern' vs './adapters/legacy'. modern exports `export const adapter = () => {}` only. on vite build the import becomes { default: { adapter: [Function] } } sometimes. runtime: "TypeError: Cannot read property 'adapter' of undefined"
ravi: that's bundler interop. recommend shipping both `export default adapter` and `export { adapter }` in shipped adapters and add a tiny sdk util: `normalizeImport(m){ return m && (m.default || m) }`. keeps consumers safe across rollup/vite/webpack.
zoe: will add sample change + docs note and a small repro repo with vite/rollup configs. also will include tsconfig variants.
max: add a smoke test in CI that bundles with esbuild and asserts normalizeImport works on the resulting bundle shape.
devx-bot: created issue RW-790: "sdk: normalize dynamic import shapes across bundlers" and assigned to @zoe and @max.
